scrape() rejects loopback addresses by default SSRF policy

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine_config = { 'ssrf_deny_private_explicit' => true }
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
  url = 'http://127.0.0.1:9/'
  result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
